name: North Long Dragon New Materials Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: North Long Dragon New Materials Tech Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sale of military vehicle supporting equipment. The company offers product showcase, interior of military vehicle human-machine-environment system, ammunition equipment, military vehicle auxiliary equipment, military vehicle communication equipment, drone products, composite material aviation packaging boxes, and other products. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Xi'an, China.
